Downtown Ventura & Mission.name: Downtown Ventura & Mission
Downtown Ventura & Mission.description: Main Street and California Street core around the Mission with adaptive-reuse storefronts, hotel conversions, and the city's densest business-license churn.

Westside & Ventura Avenue.name: Westside & Ventura Avenue
Westside & Ventura Avenue.description: Historic Ventura Avenue oil-town corridor with small-business licensing, garage-conversion permitting, and art-city warehouse reuse.

Taylor Ranch & Two Trees.name: Taylor Ranch & Two Trees
Taylor Ranch & Two Trees.description: Hillside subdivision below the Two Trees landmark with view-lot remodels, pool/deck auxiliary permits, and quiet commercial churn.

North Avenue.name: North Avenue
North Avenue.description: North Avenue valley edge with tract-home turnover and school-adjacent renovation permits.

Midtown Ventura.name: Midtown Ventura
Midtown Ventura.description: Midtown Main and Telegraph commercial strip with the city's own EconDevAreas tag, medical-office leasing, and steady alteration permitting.

Sanjon & Surfers Point.name: Sanjon & Surfers Point
Sanjon & Surfers Point.description: Beach-side midtown strip by Surfers Point with short-stay turnover, coastal-inn licensing, and boardwalk retail.

Pierpont Bay.name: Pierpont Bay
Pierpont Bay.description: Oceanfront tract between the dunes and Harbor Boulevard with beach-house remodels and high-valuation coastal permits.

Ventura Harbor & Keys.name: Ventura Harbor & Keys
Ventura Harbor & Keys.description: Harbor village, marina, and the canal-front Keys with tourism-led licensing, charter operations, and village retail churn.

Olivas & River North Bank.name: Olivas & River North Bank
Olivas & River North Bank.description: Olivas Links and the Santa Clara River north bank with golf/resort adjacency, equestrian parcels, and light commercial turnover.

College Area.name: College Area
College Area.description: College corridor around Pacific View Mall with medical and office leasing, apartment turnover, and retail-pad repositioning.

Telegraph & Thille.name: Telegraph & Thille
Telegraph & Thille.description: Telegraph Road east flats with auto-row licensing, duplex conversions, and infill townhome filings.

Wells Corridor.name: Wells Corridor
Wells Corridor.description: Wells Road commercial spine with neighborhood retail, clinic licensing, and steady residential renovation.

Serra & Juanamaria.name: Serra & Juanamaria
Serra & Juanamaria.description: Post-war east-end tracts around Serra School with starter-home turnover and garage-conversion permits.

Saticoy.name: Saticoy
Saticoy.description: Historic Saticoy village at the SOAR edge with ag-service businesses, warehouse reuse, and slow-license churn.
